title: Vihiga Launches Banja and Hamuyundi Irrigation Projects to Boost Food Security and Climate-Smart Farming
description: More than 620 farming households in Sabatia Sub-county are expected to benefit after the County Government of Vihiga launched the Banja and Hamuyundi irrigation projects.
imageAlt: Governor Dr Wilber Ottichilo joins county officials and local residents during the groundbreaking ceremony for the Banja and Hamuyundi irrigation projects in Sabatia Sub-county, symbolically laying the foundation stone to mark the start of construction. Vihiga Times

title: More Farmers in Vihiga Are Turning Small Shambas Into Reliable Sources of Income
description: Many farmers are beginning to view agriculture as a business rather than just a source of food. Local experts say smarter farming methods could open bigger opportunities for households.
imageAlt: More Farmers in Vihiga Are Turning Small Shambas Into Reliable Sources of Income

title: Mbale’s New Mega Market Could Reshape Trade and Business in Vihiga County
description: The newly launched modern market in Mbale is expected to improve business operations and attract more traders. Residents believe the project could influence economic growth across the county.
imageAlt: Mbale’s New Mega Market Could Reshape Trade and Business in Vihiga County

title: Vihiga’s Small-Scale Gold Mining Sector Takes New Direction as Safety Efforts Expand
description: Communities in Vihiga’s mining regions are witnessing gradual changes in how gold mining activities are carried out. New safety and modernization efforts are also drawing attention to the sector’s future potential.
imageAlt: Vihiga’s Small-Scale Gold Mining Sector Takes New Direction as Safety Efforts Expand
